```yaml
name: i18n Check
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
jobs:
  i18n-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'temurin'
      - name: Cache Maven packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-
      - name: Run i18n checks
        run: |
          mvn clean compile
          # Add specific i18n validation commands here
          # Example: validate message properties, check for missing translations, etc.
          echo "Running i18n validation..."
```
